title: The Inheritance Beyond the Jordan
reflectionText: Moses set before the leaders the condition for giving Gilead to Gad and Reuben. The tribes answered that they would cross armed, and the account names the towns they built. What do you notice about the connection between their stated commitment and the land assigned to them?
